event.relevance_rationale: The article details active maritime blockades, security threats, and direct attacks on cargo and container ships in critical global shipping channels (Strait of Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb, Gulf of Oman, Red Sea), which directly impacts global trade routes and PSA-bound maritime shipping logistics.
event.summary: Iranian officials state the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed to shipping until the US meets its conditions. Concurrently, maritime security threats persist with reported attacks on commercial vessels in the Gulf of Oman and Bab el-Mandeb strait, including a fatal strike on a cargo vessel and a missile strike on a container ship.
evidence: The Strait of Hormuz will remain closed as long as the US does not change its behaviour and accept Iran’s conditions to end the war
Adding to the rhetoric from both sides were reports of new attacks on shipping in the Gulf of Oman and the Red Sea, highlighting the threat to maritime trade.
A container ship was also hit by a missile off Pakistan while sailing through the Gulf of Oman, in a suspected US attack, sources said.
